variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. The event places representation at the centre of public attention. The assessment of {target} should distinguish the holding of an election from any claim about what its result authorises.

The colony has had its say at the ballot box. That is a fine thing. It is also worth remembering that a vote is not a blank cheque. The people who do the representing should expect the people being represented to keep taking an interest.

This paper reserves judgment on {target}. Holding an election establishes that a contest occurred; it does not settle every question about the conduct or merits of those involved. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.

variants.sub: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.
